subject: Choosing bedroom colours and finishes
hook: Black woodgrain and antique gold: why the pairing works.
ig:
Black woodgrain and antique gold: why the pairing works is a lesson in contrast.

This is a SUPERIO bedroom set in black woodgrain, finished with antique gold handles.

Dark finishes give a bedroom a calm, enclosed feel, which is lovely for a room you want to wind down in. On their own, though, large dark surfaces can feel heavy.

The handles do the balancing:

Antique gold catches lamp light in the evening, so the furniture glows rather than recedes.
It picks out the warmth in the woodgrain texture.
It gives each door and drawer a clear point to reach for, even in low light.

Matt black handles on the same finish would almost disappear. That suits a very minimal look, but you'd lose the warmth.

Which detail would you change, or keep exactly as it is? Tell us below, and see more fitted wardrobes via the link in bio.

A favourite detail from one of our bedroom sets: black woodgrain with antique gold handles.

Dark finishes make a bedroom feel calm and cosy, but on their own they can feel a bit heavy. The gold handles catch the light from the bedside lamps, bring out the warmth in the grain and make every drawer easy to find.

It's a good example of why we suggest choosing handles at the same time as the finish, not as an afterthought.
